learnings.title: Copilot Fusion orchestration is a paid policy-scoped Single/Cascade/Critique pattern, not an automatically free bridge
learnings.claim: GitHub's October 28, 2026 Copilot Fusion release and official docs describe three model execution patterns: Single for one-model tasks, Cascade for a cheaper draft followed by acceptance or escalation, and Critique for independently reviewed drafts. Copilot Fusion selects among policy-permitted models, can add model calls, and bills model use; it is not evidence of a connected model service or free inference in this repository.
learnings.decision: COPILOT_FUSION_COST_AND_POLICY_GATE: REVIEW_ONLY. Treat Single/Cascade/Critique as optional routing design references; retain existing free read-only API and CI workflows. Do not enable Copilot Fusion, spend credits, or claim its model routing is active without verified entitlement, policy, budget and a measured test. Preserve current required checks and access controls.
learnings.next_measurement: Read-only inventory of system routing code for actual Single/Cascade/Critique logic and billing controls; if absent, mark conceptual only. Require real test and system report applied_learning_ids before claiming applied.
fallback_history: Continue free existing GitHub Actions and read-only API checks rather than activating billable Copilot model calls.

learnings.title: Shopify Sidekick Launch requires merchant action, availability check and fail-closed no-retry semantics
learnings.claim: Shopify's October 28, 2026 Sidekick Launch API release and App Bridge reference permit embedded web admin apps to call shopify.sidekick.launch with a merchant-visible prompt only after checking isEnabled. Shopify forbids timer/page-load launches, screens prompts and rate limits requests; post-screening errors may occur after sending, so automatic retries can duplicate messages. The API is unavailable in Shopify mobile admin and does not automatically execute store changes.
learnings.decision: SHOPIFY_SIDEKICK_MERCHANT_ACTION_GATE: REVIEW_ONLY. Do not integrate unless an owned embedded web-admin app and merchant permission are verified. If adopted, check isEnabled, require a direct merchant click, keep prompts within supported bounds, handle screening rejection fail-closed and do not blindly retry ambiguous sends or perform store mutations. No implementation without a reviewed test and video_shopify manifest applied_learning_ids.
learnings.next_measurement: Search video_shopify code for App Bridge embedded app and Sidekick API usage. If no owned embedded app, mark not applicable; otherwise test availability and error paths on a safe non-production app.
fallback_history: Keep existing Shopify draft-first and read-only analytics; no Sidekick or merchant data access claim.
